run_clm_training: run causal language model training on a text dataset using GaudiTrainer on Habana Gaudi accelerators
run_clm_evaluation: evaluate a causal language model on a validation dataset and compute perplexity metrics
run_clm_streaming: run causal language model training using streaming mode for large datasets without full download
run_clm_from_scratch: train a new causal language model from scratch with custom config overrides on Habana hardware
run_clm_resume: resume causal language model training from a checkpoint using the resume_from_checkpoint argument
